notes:
- Pick a job on Home, or drop a PDF on the window: Paperly asks for the file and opens that tool.
- Black out text: the words under your boxes are removed from the file, not just covered, and
  Paperly shows what it removed before you save.
- Sign, type text, add a date or a tick, or fill the form fields a PDF already has.
- Make a PDF smaller, and see the new size before you keep it.
- Add a password, typed twice so a typo cannot lock you out. The copy opens in Preview and any
  PDF reader.
- Rearrange, rotate and delete pages, combine PDFs, split one apart, or copy pages into a new
  file. Cmd Z undoes until you save.
- Clean up a whole folder at once: shrink copies, strip their metadata or merge them.
- Every save is a new copy; your original is never touched. Show it in Finder or open it right
  away.
- Nothing leaves your Mac.
